d: In this spellbinding 2009 performance, the celebrated Shashank Subramanyam on the bansuri joins forces with the brilliant Purbayan Chatterjee on the sitar. They are accompanied by the dynamic Patri Satish Kumar on the mridangam and the masterful Sukhwinder Singh on the tabla. Together, they present a captivating rendition of Raga Sarasangi.
